gmd:otherCitationDetails.gco:CharacterString: The U.S. Geological Survey Coastal and Marine Geology Program (CMGP) Woods Hole Coastal and Marine Science Center (WHCMSC) Samples Repository is a partner repository, contributing data to the Index to Marine and Lacustrine Geological Samples (IMLGS) database. The IMLGS is a collaboration between NCEI and multiple institutions (some supported by NSF) and government agencies, created by the institutions to offer common data about, and discovery/access to geological samples in their collections. The purpose of the IMLGS is to promote new research on existing samples. The database is maintained by NCEI under the guidance of a Curators Consortium, composed of representatives from the partner institutions.

gmd:abstract.gco:CharacterString: The U.S. Geological Survey Coastal and Marine Geology Program (CMGP) Woods Hole Coastal and Marine Science Center (WHCMSC) Samples Repository is a partner in the Index to Marine and Lacustrine Geological Samples (IMLGS) database. The Curator sends data and information related to the WHCMSC marine geological sample collection to NCEI to increase their discoverability via the IMLGS. Selected data, documents, and images related to the collection are also archived at NCEI and discoverable via the IMLGS, but the USGS is the authoritative source for all data and information related to USGS geological samples.

gmd:purpose.gco:CharacterString: Information about USGS marine geosample collections is archived at NCEI to promote public access to research results and to increase their discoverability via the IMLGS.

gmd:credit.gco:CharacterString: The Curator of the USGS CMGP WHCMSC Samples Repository prepares data and information contributed to the IMLGS and the NCEI data archive.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: The name of the platform (usually a ship) that collected the geological sample.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is a controlled vocabulary list of platform (ship) names maintained at NCEI. It is a text field up to 50 characters in length, assigned by the sample repository and regularized to a standard vocabulary by NCEI. The names are checked against the list maintained by ICES, and the R2R list for consistency.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: The period of operation of a ship, during which a geological sample was taken. A cruise may contain one or more legs, or port-to-port segments.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is not a predefined set of values. The cruise identifier is a freeform text field up to 30 characters in length, assigned by the sample repository. If another, standard identifier for the cruise or leg within a cruise for a given sample, it will be coded in the leg field. This value must not be null.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: The sample may be geologic material recovered by a single grab, dredge, or core, or may indicate a single hole in the sea floor or lakebed. Within a hole/sample, there may be additional distinct down-hole cores, sections, or intervals.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is not a predefined set of values. Sample identifier is a freeform text field up to 30 characters in length, assigned by the sample repository. This value must not be null.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: The type of device used to recover a geologic sample from the sea floor or a lakebed.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: core: A coring device that is undifferentiated as far as specific type.
core, box: A shallow coring device in a box-like or rectangular shape.
core, camera mounted: A coring device mounted on a camera.
core, dart: A small coring device usually used to recover a rock sample.
core, free-fall: A free-fall specialized tubular gravity coring device
core, gravity: A coring device, driven into sediment by a weight.
core, hand-held: A hand operated coring device.
core, kastenlot: A long, rectangular gravity corer.
core, multicorer: A device taking multiple, small, tubular cores at once.
core, piston: A tubular sampling device, with an inner piston, used to recover sediment.
core, piston(giant): A piston coring device that is longer and wider in diameter than a standard piston corer.
core, submersible mounted: A coring device mounted on a submersible vehicle.
core, vibrating: A sediment coring device, with a vibrating mechanism, often used to recover coarse sediments, such as sand.
corer, trigger wt.: A small core mounted on a larger piston core. When the trigger wt. corer hits the sediment surface, it causes the piston to activate within the piston core.
downhole coring: Used to indicate a hole from which multiple individual coring devices have sequentially extracted geologic samples, down the hole.
dredge: A device dragged along the seabed surface, to recover geologic material.
dredge (old fmt): Used to indicate a dredging device where sample information was entered into the database using old descriptors.
dredge, rock: A dredging device specifically designed to recover rock samples.
drill: A drilling device that is undifferentiated as to specific type.
drill, rock: A drilling device designed to obtain rock samples.
drill, sediment: A drilling device designed to recover sediment.
grab: A sampling device designed to recover undifferentiated material from the surface of the sea floor or lakebed.
grab, ROV: A grab sampler mounted/operated from a remotely operated vehicle.
probe: Indicates a sample taken in conjunction with a sea floor probe.
suspended sediment: A sampling device designed to recover sediment suspended above the sea floor.
trap, sediment: A device intended to trap sediment over time to measure sediment transport.
trawl: A net dragged along the sea floor.
unknown device: Used in all cases when the sampling device is unknown, the field must not be null.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: The name of the lake from which a geological sample was collected.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is not a predefined set of values. Lake is a freeform text field up to 50 characters in length, assigned by the sample repository and compiled into an alphabetical list by NCEI.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: International Geosample Number (IGSN).

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: http://geosamples.org.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: IMLGS identifier

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: A unique number preceded by imlgs representing one record in the Index to Marine and Lacustrine Geological Samples database

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: A definitive cruiseleg identifier used to cross reference the sample material to additional information about the cruse and leg on which it was collected. May also be used to specify an alternative leg identifier to the cruise parameter.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is not a predefined set of values. Values are determined by a variety of definitive sources, such as the Marine Geoscience Data System (MGDS), the Scripps Institution of Oceanography SIO Explorer, the R2R system, and the US Geological Survey InfoBank, among others. It consists of a community consensus definitive identifier for a particular cruise leg combination, and may change over time.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: A URL linking sample level information in the database to additional data and information outside the database, usually archived by NCEI, related to the sample. For example, core photographs, descriptions, or analyses.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is not a predefined set of values. It consists of a valid program call/URL up to 500 characters in length.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: Comments about a whole core, grab, dredge, or hole.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is not a predefined set of values. Freeform text field up to 2000 characters in length.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: URL to link detailed interval level information to a whole core, grab, dredge, or hole.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is not a predefined set of values. Freeform text field up to 254 characters in length.

gmi:definition.gco:CharacterString: A distinct down-hole core taken sequentially down a multi-core hole.

gmi:rangeElement.gco:Record: This is not a predefined set of values. Downhole core identifier is a freeform text field up to 30 characters in length, assigned by the sample repository.

gmd:evaluationMethodDescription.gco:CharacterString: Samples are intermittently collected and added to the repository collection. Completeness of data in the IMLGS is determined by submission schedule of the repository.
Recently collected samples may still be in processing by the sample repository and not yet available via searches of the IMLGS.

gmd:measureDescription.gco:CharacterString: NCEI works with the partner institutions to ensure that sample data published in the IMLGS conforms to agreed upon formats and vocabularies, but cannot guarantee the accuracy of the information itself.

gmd:evaluationMethodDescription.gco:CharacterString: The horizontal accuracy of data values is approximately .001 degree of latitude/longitude.

Quality control is performed by originator and also in coordination with NCEI after data submission. Numeric data are subjected to out of range testing at NCEI, then posted on a test web site for inspection by the originator. Data are iteratively corrected at NCEI until the originator approves their publication to the production database.

gmd:statement.gco:CharacterString: Data are received by NCEI on an intermittent basis from the repository. Incoming data are checked for adherence to controlled vocabularies, illegal data types in numeric fields, and out of range latitudes/longitudes. NCEI adds IGSNs/links to related resources, where known, and may perform cursory visual inspection of data for reasonableness, asking the originator for guidance on discrepancies. Preliminary processed data are placed in a test database for inspection by the originator, and iteratively corrected until the originator approves their publication to the production database. Data may also be updated/corrected at any time, at the originator's request.
